name: halfmoon
source:
Mio has died. But all that awaited her after death...was work.

Mio, the dead main character, was recruited to work at the Afterlife Information Center, a place for the dead to go before they move on.

Join Mio as she works at this mysterious information center with the help of her experienced colleagues, Nami and Rei.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4175330/]Steam[/url]]
